title: Containerize Your R Project
text: containr helps researchers containerize R projects. generates Dockerfile project’s renv.lock, builds container image, pushes registry — analyses can reliably shared, archived, rerun across systems without worrying software versions system configuration.

title: Containerize Your R Project
text: Containerizing R project containr follows four steps. first three happen inside R; authentication container registry happens terminal push. 1. Generate Dockerfile — generate_dockerfile() reads renv.lock file, auto-detects system libraries packages need, writes ready--use Dockerfile. Run many times needed refining configuration. writes text file, iteration fast cheap. 2. Build container image — build_image() passes Dockerfile podman docker builds image locally. first build takes time — downloads base image installs R packages scratch. Subsequent builds reuse cached layers much faster, rebuilding adding packages renv.lock costly looks. 3. Inspect local images — list_images() returns data frame images local store, equivalent running podman image ls terminal. Use find image ID need pass push_image(). 4. Push registry — push_image() tags image full registry path pushes container registry. Currently targets UW-Madison CHTC registry registry.doit.wisc.edu default.

title: Containerize Your R Project
text: containr includes functions wrap system commands (podman, docker). tested end--end standard test suite require running container daemon, real images, case push_image(), live registry valid credentials. test suite addresses three-layer strategy. Layer 1 — Argument validation. Tests bad arguments error correctly required arguments enforced. pure R checks system dependencies always run every platform, including CRAN. Layer 2 — Command construction. Tests correct system command assembled supplied arguments. dry_run = TRUE key mechanism — causes function print command executed without running . local_mocked_bindings() intercepts .resolve_tool() .check_tool_responsive() tests run without container tool installed. always run every platform. Layer 3 — Integration. Tests call real system commands live container environment. Guarded skip_if_not(nchar(Sys.("podman")) > 0) run podman available PATH. never run CRAN CI — intended run locally release part manual pre-submission checklist.

text: generate_dockerfile() inspects R project's dependencies via renv lockfile writes ready--use Dockerfile specified output directory. supports multiple Rocker base images, optional system libraries, Quarto installation, file copying, user creation, inline documentation comments.

title: Generate a reproducible Dockerfile for an R project — generate_dockerfile
code: generate_dockerfile(   verbose = FALSE,   r_version = "current",   data_file = NULL,   code_file = NULL,   misc_file = NULL,   add_user = NULL,   home_dir = "/home",   install_quarto = FALSE,   expose_port = "8787",   r_mode = "base",   install_syslibs = TRUE,   comments = FALSE,   output = tempdir() )

title: Generate a reproducible Dockerfile for an R project — generate_dockerfile
text: verbose Logical. TRUE, prints progress messages section Dockerfile written. Defaults FALSE. r_version character string specifying R version use, e.g. "4.3.0". Defaults "current", resolves version R running current session. data_file character string. Path optional data file copy container /home/data/. Defaults NULL. code_file character string. Path optional script file (e.g. .R, .qmd, .rmd) copy container /home/. Defaults NULL. misc_file character string. Path optional miscellaneous file (e.g. image shell script) copy container /home/. Defaults NULL. add_user character string. Name Linux user create inside container sudo access. Defaults NULL. home_dir character string. working directory set inside container via WORKDIR. Defaults "/home". install_quarto Logical. TRUE, downloads installs Quarto CLI inside container. Defaults FALSE. expose_port character string. port expose r_mode "rstudio". Defaults "8787". Ignored r_mode "rstudio". r_mode character string selecting Rocker base image. Inspired Rocker Project. One "base" plain R, "tidyverse" R tidyverse, "rstudio" RStudio Server, "tidystudio" tidyverse plus TeX Live publishing-related packages. Defaults "base". install_syslibs Logical. TRUE, installs system libraries commonly required R packages needed source compilation (e.g. libcurl4-openssl-dev, libxml2-dev). Defaults TRUE. comments Logical. TRUE, annotates Dockerfile instruction explanatory comment. Useful learning sharing. Defaults FALSE. output character string. Directory path Dockerfile written. Defaults tempdir().

title: containr 0.1.3.9000
text: build_image() builds container image Dockerfile using either podman docker. Auto-detects tool available, preferring podman. Supports dry_run = TRUE preview build command without executing . verbose comments follow contract generate_dockerfile(). push_image() tags locally built container image full registry path pushes container registry single call, handling podman tag podman push steps internally. Arguments: image_id, netid, project, tag (defaults "latest"), registry (defaults "registry.doit.wisc.edu"). Supports login verification, dry_run = TRUE, guided output via verbose comments. list_images() returns data frame container images local image store, reported podman image ls docker image ls. Useful finding image ID pass push_image() building image build_image(). Prints data frame console returns invisibly. Two new internal helpers shared build_image(), push_image(), list_images(): .resolve_tool() auto-detects podman docker PATH, .check_tool_responsive() verifies daemon running attempting build, push, list operation.

title: containr 0.1.3.9000
text: generate_dockerfile() refactored: r_mode validated file network operations, dplyr dependency removed, expose_port now warns r_mode "rstudio", build loop simplified, invisible(NULL) added return value. generate_dockerfile() now requires renv.lock file current working directory. Errors informatively none found, instructions run renv::snapshot(). New auto_syslibs argument (default TRUE) reads renv.lock, queries Posit Package Manager sysreqs database via remotes::system_requirements(), automatically includes system libraries required packages lock file. Warns continues without auto-detection lookup fails. New install_syslibs argument (default NULL) accepts character vector additional apt package names install top auto-detected set, e.g. install_syslibs = c("libuv1-dev", "libwebp-dev"). curl now always installed baseline system package regardless auto_syslibs install_syslibs. required renv package downloads inside container. Breaking change: hardcoded system library list (cmake, libcurl4-openssl-dev, libssl-dev, etc.) removed. Libraries now determined entirely auto_syslibs install_syslibs. old install_syslibs = TRUE argument longer works — pass character vector library names instead. generate_dockerfile() now calls renv::status() defensively warns lock file appears sync project library. success message now reports path Dockerfile written verbose = TRUE.
